headline: Bruno Fernandes: Late call due to illness for Man United vs. Brentford - sources
description: Bruno Fernandes will be assessed ahead of Manchester United's Premier League clash with Brentford on Saturday after missing training on Friday because of illness, sources have told ESPN.

headline: 'Cole Palmer is the best No. 10 in the Premier League' - Tosin Adarabioyo
description: Tottenham's Tosin Adarabioyo has said that Cole Palmer is "the best No. 10 in the Premier League" and "one of the best players he has ever seen."

headline: Would any USMNT players really make Man United better if they followed Poch?
description: Now that USMNT manager Mauricio Pochettino has taken over Man United, would it make sense for USMNT players to join their ex-coach?

headline: Transfer rumors, news:Transfer rumors, news: Nico Paz open to Man United; against Real Madrid return
description: Manchester United see Como's Nico Paz as a possible replacement for Bruno Fernandes. For his part, Paz is at least open to it. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man United-linked Dominic Calvert-Lewin signs new Leeds contract
description: Leeds United have announced striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin has signed a new two-and-a-half-year contract with the club.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barça, Madrid jockey for position in Erling Haaland chase
description: Barcelona and Real Madrid are positioning themselves for a move for Man City striker Erling Haaland. Transfer Talk has the latest.
